topic: What does Capiro have on program element 0605231A for FY27 versus FY26? Keep it to one short paragraph with sources.

heldReview.reason: Grounding auditor: D4b (high): Sentence has one budget vehicle do the other’s job. Authorization (NDAA; HASC/SASC) sets policy/ceilings; appropriations (HAC-D/SAC-D/enacted) provide money — they are different bills and must not be blended.

findings.span: Its recorded FY27 HASC and SASC authorization marks and HAC-D appropriations mark each equal the FY27 request; HAC-D is the latest recorded stage, **not enacted funding**.
findings.detail: Sentence has one budget vehicle do the other’s job. Authorization (NDAA; HASC/SASC) sets policy/ceilings; appropriations (HAC-D/SAC-D/enacted) provide money — they are different bills and must not be blended.
